markets.title: Will India's WEI exceed 50.0 by end of 2026?
markets.description: Resolves YES if SHEtoken annual WEI publication shows India >= 50.0. India current WEI: 47.7. Trend: +0.5/year. Requires acceleration.
markets.notes: Requires Kanyashree expansion + crime reduction + digital push

markets.title: Will Afghanistan exit EMBARGO status by end of 2027?
markets.description: Resolves YES if Afghanistan WEI exceeds 20.0, removing EMBARGO rating. Current WEI: 4.0. Would require fundamental political change.

markets.title: Will Saudi Arabia reach ACCEPTABLE rating (WEI > 55) by 2027?
markets.description: Saudi Arabia current WEI: 44. ACCEPTABLE threshold: 55. Vision 2030 driving rapid change. Possible but ambitious.

markets.title: Will Global WEI exceed 57.0 in the 2026 annual report?
markets.description: Global WEI 2024: 55.9. Trend: +0.4/year. Requires slightly above-trend.
markets.notes: Possible but requires no major regression events

markets.title: Will West Bengal's WEI exceed Kerala's by end of 2028?
markets.description: WB current: 50.0. KL current: 60.3. WB is the fastest-improving state (+3.4/yr). Closing the gap requires sustained Kanyashree and Lakshmi Bhandar impact.
markets.notes: Kerala has structural advantages. Very unlikely but possible.

markets.title: Will Mississippi's WEI improve by more than 3 points by end of 2026?
markets.description: Mississippi current WEI: 40.5. Requires policy change or measurable improvement in health/economic indicators post-Dobbs.
markets.notes: Hard. Structural issues + total abortion ban = headwinds.

markets.title: Will Texas bodily autonomy score exceed 20 by end of 2028?
markets.description: Texas bodily autonomy: 1/100 post-Dobbs. Resolves YES only if Texas abortion law is overturned or significantly modified, moving the WEI bodily autonomy score above 20.
markets.notes: Legal challenges ongoing. 2028 election matters enormously.

markets.title: Will India criminalise marital rape by end of 2027?
markets.description: India is one of 20+ countries where marital rape is not criminalised. Supreme Court is currently considering the matter. Resolves YES if Indian Parliament passes legislation or Supreme Court ruling criminalises marital rape before 2028.
markets.resolution_source: SHEtoken SVI annual report + Indian court/legislative record
markets.notes: SC case ongoing. Feminist movement strong. Political resistance high.

markets.title: Will Bangladesh criminalise marital rape by end of 2027?
markets.description: Bangladesh marital rape currently legal. Reform pressure growing from BNWLA and feminist groups.
markets.notes: Less likely than India. Political instability after 2024.

markets.title: Will 5 or more countries criminalise marital rape by end of 2028?
markets.description: Currently 20+ countries where marital rape is legal. Resolves YES if at least 5 of those countries pass criminalisation legislation by end of 2028.
markets.notes: Slow but steady global trend. UN pressure accelerating.

markets.title: Will Kanyashree reach 12M girls enrolled by end of 2026?
markets.description: Kanyashree current enrollment: 10M girls. West Bengal government target: 12M by 2027. Resolves YES if WB government reports >= 12M enrolled.
markets.resolution_source: West Bengal WCD Department annual report + SHEtoken verification

markets.title: Will 100+ companies sign the Women's Rights Trade Commitment by 2027?
markets.description: WRTC launches with SHEtoken. Resolves YES if 100 or more companies publicly sign the commitment by end of 2027.
markets.notes: Needs 2 anchor signatories to trigger network effect.

markets.title: Will Japan's GPI exceed 75.0 by end of 2027?
markets.description: Japan GPI current: 77.3. Wait — this resolves YES easily. Revised: Will Japan's time poverty dimension exceed 45 by 2027? Current: 38. Japan women do 3.8x more care work than men.
markets.notes: Japan 2023 equal pay reforms. Slow cultural change.

markets.title: Will India's female land ownership GPI dimension exceed 20 by 2027?
markets.description: India women own only 14% of land. GPI land dimension: 28. Resolves YES if SHEtoken GPI shows India land dimension > 20/100.
markets.notes: Inheritance law on books since 2005. Enforcement is the barrier.

markets.title: Will Bangladesh's WADI reskilling score improve by 10+ points by 2028?
markets.description: Bangladesh reskilling access: 12/100. Resolves YES if SHEtoken WADI shows Bangladesh reskilling > 22 by 2028. Requires garment sector just transition fund + government program.
markets.notes: Requires brand funding commitment. Possible if ACT fund expands.

mechanics.protocol: Fork of Polymarket/Augur v2 smart contracts

why_prediction_markets: Creates continuous trading activity between annual WEI updates. Traders research women's rights trends to gain edge. Aggregates real-world expert beliefs about policy trajectory. Platform fee (0.5%) flows to WEI Impact Fund on every trade.
